name: משוואת ישר – דרך נקודה עם שיפוע נתון (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Find the equation of a straight line in the \((x,y)\) plane which passes through \(({{CT:0}},{{CT:1}})\) and has gradient \({{CT:2}}\).

 [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Recall that the equation of a straight line passing through the point \((x_1,y_1)\) with gradient \(m\) is \[y-y_1=m(x-x_1).\]
 So substituting in the values we get: \[y-{{CT:1}}={{CT:2}}(x-{{CT:0}}),\]
 Which gives the equation of the line:
 \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
 y - {{CT:1}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:2}}(x-{{CT:0}}),\\
 y - {{CT:1}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:2}}x - {{CT:3}},\\
 y &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:2}}x + {{CT:4}}.
  \end{array}\]

on_true.feedback: It seems you have forgotten to multiply the gradient, \(m\) and \(x_1\).
